compiler: existing local WSL g++15.2.0; CPU executable only

hypotheses.claim: For every finite BF16 x and BF16 group amax>=abs(x), scale RN32(amax/6) (zero fallback included), B without its RN64 compatibility increment has identical canonical base and threshold to source A-double-prime.
hypotheses.falsifier: Any valid pair with different canonical base/T. A global no-correction claim fails on a single pair; retain complete counts if budget permits.
hypotheses.candidate: One CPU-only clone of B removing only the final RN64 correction branch. No new CUDA candidate.

hypotheses.claim: A useful additional removal/necessity rule can be derived from the legal producer domain rather than the already-known generic B guard.
hypotheses.test: Classify all carry witnesses by generated scale, BF16 significand/exponent and exact remainder; if D1 has no carry, report finite-domain equivalence plus a mathematical reason if proved.
hypotheses.failure: No nontrivial rule beyond the existing generic correction test; no claim of a new selector, theorem or method from enumeration alone.

domain.negative_values: threshold magnitude proof plus fixed signed smoke checks; sign code preserved by bit separation
domain.arbitrary_F32_scale: not included in domain; old witness negative control only

order: all-zero then increasing positive amax then increasing magnitude x; no data-dependent case selection
independent_reference: CPU compiled actual A-double-prime function plus separately implemented integer-u128 round-rational-to-binary64 oracle; scale bits independently generated by Fraction RNE
metrics: integer RN64 oracle vs A disagreement
RN64 carry count and generic guard count
per-amax counts and first up to32 witnesses

smoke.purpose: verify source extraction, integer oracle, signed corners and estimate full-sweep cost; not evidence for full-domain theorem

main: One complete magnitude-pair traversal, no automatic retry. Abort on compiler/tool error, baseline/oracle disagreement or budget exhaustion; retain diagnostics.
proof_limit: Finite verification of this CPU semantics does not prove compiled CUDA or novel proof technology.
application_track: Only after D1/D2 outcome; at most one proposed transport use, payload+metadata and producer cost lower bound, no hypothetical GPU speedup.
review: One fresh independent R after frozen results; no contact with preexisting research agents/chats.
termination: Write results then stop; no GPU, remote, paid use, manuscript edits or automatic followup.
